notes.title: Spooky Update 1
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! 

Thank you so much for your feedback and trying out our game Ghoul Kid! 

Our team has been hard at work making fixes and updates to the game.

We’ve added in Steam Achievements as well as a credits page!

Updates:

Trick or Treat mode is now more intense but it only takes one scare to get a kill.
We sped up a few of the object animations so you can keep chaining scares!
Smoothed out the camera movement between rooms.
Increased the range of the candles in the kitchen so more house guests can get scared by them.
The opening cut scene now plays at the beginning of play mode. You can still skip it of course.


Thank you again for your feedback. We hope you enjoy these updates!
-Specter Game Studios
